about.eyebrow: YOUR EDGE IN THE LAND OF DAWN
about.title: A better player, one game at a time.
about.text: Nexus is an independent educational companion for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. Explore heroes, experiment with builds, and learn at your own pace.
about.calloutText: Imported hero data comes from the official hero guide; stats, tier placements and item effects marked “estimated” or “editorial” are illustrative. Verify in-game values before ranked play.
about.legal: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang and its characters belong to MOONTON. Nexus is not affiliated with or endorsed by MOONTON. Hero artwork is used for this educational prototype; the main banner is original generated artwork.

hero.statsEstimated: Estimated values — not verified for the current patch
hero.nextStepText: Get familiar with {name}’s skills, then adapt a build to your matchup. Practice the basics before taking it into ranked.
hero.skillDisclaimer: Skill text follows the in-game hero guide at import time; cooldowns and costs shown as “—” are not verified for the current patch.
hero.noBuild: No approved build yet. Create one and submit it for review.
hero.buildDisclaimer: Adapt to the enemy lineup. A recommended build is a starting point, not a rule.
hero.countersText: These curated picks can disrupt {name}’s game plan. Your timing and team composition still matter.
hero.noCounters: No counters have been curated for this hero yet.
hero.beFirst: Be the first to rate this hero.
hero.startDiscussion: Have a useful tip? Start the discussion.
hero.commentPlaceholder: Share a tip, combo, or helpful matchup insight…
hero.reportTitle: Help us keep the library accurate.
hero.reportPlaceholder: What needs to be corrected? Include the skill, stat, or patch if possible.

builds.title: Your build. Your advantage.
builds.subtitle: Find the right six items for the fight ahead.
builds.noSaved: No saved builds yet. Create a loadout and save it here.
builds.noItemsText: Try a different name or category.

counters.title: The right answer to their draft.
counters.subtitle: Select an enemy hero. Find a pick that puts the odds on your side.
counters.noCounters: No curated counters yet for this hero.
counters.noCountersText: The owner can add counter picks from the admin workspace.
counters.reasonTank: Reliable crowd control disrupts mobility and creates space for your team.
counters.reasonAssassin: Precise target access can punish overextension before the enemy escapes.
counters.reasonSupport: Protect your damage dealers and deny the opponent’s key engage window.
counters.reasonDefault: Well-timed abilities and disciplined spacing can disrupt the enemy’s game plan.
counters.calloutTitle: A counter is an opportunity, not a guarantee.
counters.calloutText: Consider comfort, lane matchups, and your team’s composition. These picks are editorial guidance, not calculated win predictions.

tier.title: A little draft intelligence.
tier.subtitle: Explore the curated tiers. Add your voice to the community ratings.
tier.empty: No heroes in this tier for the selected role.
tier.calloutText: Tier placements are curated by the admin. Your 1–5 ratings are recorded separately and appear in each hero’s Community tab. One rating per hero per browser profile; you can change it anytime.
tier.unratedNote: {count} imported heroes are not yet placed in a tier. They appear in the hero library with an “Awaiting review” badge.
tier.separate: Your rating is saved separately from the editorial tier.
tier.voteSaved: Your vote has been saved. Thanks for sharing your perspective!

guides.videoUnsupported: Your browser does not support embedded video.

tools.title: Make every second count.
tools.subtitle: Simple tools. Sharper decisions.
tools.stayAhead: Stay ahead of the next objective.
tools.timersText: Start a timer when an objective is taken. Customize durations for your game mode.
tools.complete: {name} timer complete — time to check the objective.
tools.calloutTitle: Your practice companion, not a game integration.
tools.calloutText: These are manual countdown timers with example respawn durations. First-spawn times and timers vary by patch and game mode. Adjust them to match your game. Running timers continue to track elapsed time while you browse.
tools.emblemDisclaimer: An illustrative linear-growth calculator. Not an exact simulation of the current emblem system or adaptive-stat selection.

admin.subtitle: Keep the playbook useful, accurate, and yours.
admin.previewText: Public content is visible. Sign in with your owner credentials and a 2FA code to edit content or view private analytics.
admin.assistantText: Turn notes into a useful draft
admin.privateText: Sign in to see real visitor analytics. No sample numbers are shown here.
admin.noVisitsText: Hero visits will appear as players explore the public library.
admin.protectedText: All content mutations require your signed admin session, a CSRF token, and same-origin validation. Community submissions use a separate moderated workflow.
admin.nothingMatchedText: Try a different name or add new content.
admin.reviewPrivateText: Sign in to approve builds and comments or resolve accuracy reports.
admin.noBuilds: New community build suggestions will appear here.
admin.aiSubtitle: Turn rough notes into a structured educational draft. You decide what gets published.
admin.notesText: Write naturally in English or Persian. Include only the facts you want to preserve.
admin.notesPlaceholder: Add your raw hero notes or guide outline here…
admin.aiSuggestsText: No tools or database access are provided to the model. Generating a draft never changes live content.
admin.draftTitle: A draft, not a final answer.
admin.draftRoomText: Your formatted draft appears here. Review game facts and patch values before publishing.
admin.draftCopied: Draft copied. Review it before publishing.
admin.clipboard: Clipboard unavailable. Select the draft text and copy it manually.
admin.draftAdded: Draft added to the editor. Review and save to publish.
